title: Compath Choir Rehearsal
tagline: A private rehearsal library for choirs: songs, voice tracks, PDF scores, and easy listening on phone or desktop.
overview: Choir Rehearsal helps choir members learn new pieces by voice part. Editors upload PDF scores and audio for each voice. Singers visit /rehearsal/, pick a song, and listen. Lite is free from GitHub; Pro is a separate add-on from shop.compath.ee (keep Lite installed — do not replace it).
features: Song library — paginated list on your choir website with shortcode embedding
PDF scores — attach sheet music and flip pages in the built-in viewer
Voice tracks — bass, tenor, alto, soprano and more
Sticky player — listen while reading the score
Private access — optional login-only rehearsal pages
Editor & singer roles — editors manage, singers listen
Lite (free) — up to 4 tracks per song, audio upload, GitHub updates
Pro add-on — unlimited tracks, mic recording, search, editor Play, embedded PDF in the editor

orderSteps: Open https://shop.compath.ee/products/choir-rehearsal-pro/ (or email order@compath.ee for setup services).
After payment, download choir-rehearsal-pro.zip from your SureCart customer dashboard.
Keep Choir Rehearsal (Lite) installed. Upload and activate the Pro add-on beside it — do not replace Lite.
installSteps: In WordPress: Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin — activate Lite.
Pro customers: upload choir-rehearsal-pro.zip next and activate it. Settings should show Edition: Pro.
The plugin creates a /rehearsal/ page with the [choir_rehearsal] shortcode.
Add a song: Choir Rehearsal → Add Song — title, PDF, voice tracks.
Give singers WordPress accounts (Subscriber). Editors need Editor or Administrator.
